Your café is open. But online, nobody can find you. ☕️

I gave this owner five minutes and a simple, fast website — menu with prices, real food photos, and a green WhatsApp order button. One "NEW ORDER" ping later, the room was full.

Most local businesses don't need a big rebrand. They need to be findable.
